thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: REAL-TIME DETECTOR: p99 latency breach on /v1/generate (hosted-api, eu-west1). p95=420ms, p99=2.3s over last 1m. alert_id=LT-7755.

maya_sre: I'm on it — starting quick triage. Are we seeing increased queue depth or KV-cache misses?

ethan_runtime: checking runtime dashboards now. live graph: https://dash.redwood.local/rd/7755 (last 5m). looks like a tail spike on streaming responses, increased retransmit errors on worker-13.

diego_support: any customer impact? any 503s reported?

incident-bot: No 5xx spikes detected. Error rate steady. Affected requests mainly streaming/chunked responses from large-context jobs (seq > 1024).

priya_ops: Quick mitigation idea: route new requests in eu-west1 to dedicated-pool-b temporarily, and reduce max_concurrency on hosted pool from 16 -> 8 to lower head-of-line stalls. Can we flip that without a deploy?

ethan_runtime: We can toggle routing policy via console. Doing a dry-run: `rbctl route set --region eu-west1 --policy fallback:dedicated-pool-b --dry-run`

maya_sre: While Ethan tests, can someone run a sampling query to capture a slow request trace? `curl -H "x-request-id: triage-7755" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{...}'` — we need a trace_id to correlate.

diego_support: pinging a couple customers in EU on active sessions to check UX. Lina, want me to include SL message template?

lina_csm: Yes please — short note: "We're investigating intermittent latency in eu-west1 for streaming responses. No data loss. We'll update in 30 mins." I'll queue it if impact grows.

ethan_runtime: Dry-run route change looks safe. Applying now: `rbctl route set --region eu-west1 --policy fallback:dedicated-pool-b --reason "p99 spike"` -> applied. Also lowering batch window on hosted API to 20ms temporarily.

incident-bot: change applied by ethan_runtime at 775555 (audit id A-7755). Watch metrics for 2 minutes.

maya_sre: Observing p99 drop from 2.3s -> 1.1s after routing, and tail stalls reduced. p95 stable ~430ms. Still seeing occasional 1.2s spikes tied to specific model v2.3.

ethan_runtime: Rolling a selective fallback: for sequences > 2048, route to quantized-model-v2 as a compatibility fallback. Implementing rule now.

priya_ops: If fallback sticks, we'll open a dedicated scaling job to add +2 GPUs to dedicated-pool-b. ETA ~6m.

diego_support: No customer complaints yet. Lina queued the proactive note to customers.

lina_csm: Sent message to affected workspace list and top customers. Triage update included.

maya_sre: Next steps: 1) keep routing in place for 10m, 2) collect slow traces (trace_ids logged), 3) run model-variant perf test on worker-13 to reproduce. If p99 returns >1.8s, escalate to incident bridge.

ethan_runtime: Collected 3 traces: triage-7755-1, triage-7755-2, triage-7755-3. Uploading to /incidents/7755/traces.

incident-bot: Monitoring window started. Will post another automated status in 5m.

maya_sre: tagging SRE rotation: @oncall-sre to keep an eye; handoff to Priya if we need infra scaling.

priya_ops: Acknowledged — standing by to scale.

diego_support: I'll keep customer comms open and update if we see degradations.

maya_sre: Thanks team — for now mitigation looks effective. If anyone sees a customer-facing error or p99 regresses, call the bridge.

ethan_runtime: Logging final note: suspected root cause = transient KV-cache thrash on worker-13 triggered by high large-context streaming mix. Follow-up: increase KV cache retention and add eviction metrics alert.

incident-bot: Automated follow-up ticket created: INC-7755 (owner: eng-runtime).
